title: fix(app-shell): the plan-locked environment list draws a locked tier mark, not a paywall-dialog button
body:
Fixes #12190

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `@object-ui/i18n` adds two keys to all ten locale packs (a widening) and removes one, `environment.addEnvironment` (a narrowing of a published key); no export of `@object-ui/app-shell` changes.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM (claim comment 6121025853); session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd`. Draft by contract: CI convergence, ready and queueing are the seat's. The round-2 edits to this body (head `e5c45317`) are the seat's, from the dev's round-2 report (comment `6122499354` on objectui#12190).

## What changed

The maintainer accepted that no primary button opens a paywall dialog (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 3, objectstack-ai/cloud#2775). On a free-plan organization's environment list, the `upgrade_for_development` branch of `EnvironmentListToolbar` drew the page's only primary button, "Add environment" (zh 「新建环境」), whose click opened the "Development environments are a paid feature" dialog; the `?runAction=create_environment` deep link opened the same dialog.

- The branch now draws an **outline mark with a lock icon**, "Development environments · Team plan and up" (zh 「开发环境 · 团队版起」), in place of the create action. It is a plain link to the entitlement summary's `upgradeUrl`, resolved with the entitlement dialog's own `resolveCtaHref` (a control-plane-relative path is prefixed with `VITE_SERVER_URL`; an absolute URL opens in a new tab). **No dialog.**
- **No `upgradeUrl`** in the summary: the mark is drawn **unlinked** (a non-interactive span with the same outline shape). Reason: the URL is the control plane's to name and none is composed in the console (objectui#10437, the rule the dialog already follows), while the fact the mark states is still true and is the page's only explanation of why it has no create button. Hiding it would leave a free-plan owner with no create affordance and no reason.
- **Deep link** under `upgrade_for_development`: still consumed (stripped from the URL) by the unchanged `useNavRunAction` arming predicate, and now opens nothing. The effect that opened the dialog is gone. The comment above `useAutoRunCreate` says why consuming is right here: the locked mark is the page's whole answer to "create" in that state, so the one-shot intent is spent on that answer, not lost.
- The mark appears only where the create action would have rendered (the #4123 one-list rule is unchanged), so a create action dropped by placement or by the capability gate still leaves nothing.
- Test id: `environment-add-upgrade` becomes `environment-development-locked`.
- Unchanged: `setup_production`, `add_development`, the loading skeleton, the settled-no-signal metadata label, and the reactive refusal dialog.

## i18n keys (all ten packs)

| Key | Change |
|---|---|
| `planTier.teamAndUp` | added — the tier label, a new top-level namespace keyed by the TIER so any plan-locked mark reuses it |
| `environment.developmentLocked` | added — the mark's text, with a `{{tier}}` placeholder the toolbar fills from `planTier.teamAndUp` |
| `environment.addEnvironment` | removed — its one reader was the retired button (`git grep` outside the packs: zero hits after the change) |

Values:

| Pack | `planTier.teamAndUp` | `environment.developmentLocked` |
|---|---|---|
| en | Team plan and up | Development environments · {{tier}} |
| zh | 团队版起 | 开发环境 · {{tier}} |
| ja | Team プラン以上 | 開発環境 · {{tier}} |
| ko | Team 요금제 이상 | 개발 환경 · {{tier}} |
| de | Ab Tarif Team | Entwicklungsumgebungen · {{tier}} |
| fr | À partir de l'offre Team | Environnements de développement · {{tier}} |
| es | Desde el plan Team | Entornos de desarrollo · {{tier}} |
| pt | A partir do plano Team | Ambientes de desenvolvimento · {{tier}} |
| ru | Тариф Team и выше | Окружения разработки · {{tier}} |
| ar | خطة Team وما فوقها | بيئات التطوير · {{tier}} |

**Composing the tier label from a plan key (the cloud seat's rule, comment 6121919252 on objectui#12197) — measured, not possible today, so the literal tier key stays as dispatched.** Two inputs are missing: (1) the entitlement summary objectui reads (`EnvironmentEntitlementsSummary`: `plan`, `hasProductionEnv`, `production`, `development` with `used`/`limit`/`canCreate`, `seatCount`, `upgradeUrl`, `contactSalesUrl`, `workspaceTimezoneSeed`) carries the org's CURRENT plan, not the tier development environments require, so composing from `data.plan` would print "free" for a free org; (2) objectui's packs have no per-plan label vocabulary: only `environment.entitlement.freePlan` and `namedPlan` (`'{{plan}} plan'`, which interpolates the raw plan code). Composing would need a required-tier field on the cloud summary for development environments, a plan-label vocabulary (or cloud-supplied localized labels), and one interpolating key such as `'{{plan}} and up'` (zh `'{{plan}}起'`). Not added here.

## `@object-ui/app-shell` exported symbols

- **Changed: none.** The package's `exports` map is `.` (`dist/index.js`) and `./styles.css`. `src/index.ts` and the seven sub-barrels it re-exports (`hooks`, `views`, `context`, `utils`, `layout`, `chrome`, `observability`) re-export nothing from `src/environment/` (grep, with `ObjectView` in `views/index.ts` as the positive control).
- **Removed as dead (unpublished):** `upgradeDialogSpec` in `environment/entitlements.ts`. Its two production callers were the toolbar's effect and button, both gone; its remaining readers were its own tests, removed with it.
- **Not dead:** `EntitlementDialogSpec` — still the type of `entitlementDialogFromError`, `EnvironmentEntitlementDialog` and `useConsoleActionRuntime.openEntitlementDialog` (the reactive path).
- **Removed as dead (unpublished), round 2 at `e5c45317`:** `EnvironmentListToolbar`'s `onUpgrade` prop, its doc comment and the `EntitlementDialogSpec` import there, plus the one `onUpgrade` attribute on the `EnvironmentListToolbar` element in `views/ObjectView.tsx` (claim amendment `6122200077`). `EnvironmentListToolbar` is not exported.

## Tests

Test-file changes, all under `packages/app-shell/src/environment/__tests__/`:

- `EnvironmentListToolbar.test.tsx`: new describe `plan-locked: a locked mark, no paywall dialog (objectui#12190)` — the mark is an `A` to `/settings/billing` with the lock svg and no button of any kind; a click renders no `alertdialog` (since round 2 the toolbar has no prop through which to ask for a dialog); other toolbar actions still render beside it; an absolute `upgradeUrl` is linked verbatim with `target=_blank`; no `upgradeUrl` gives an unlinked `SPAN`; zh renders 「开发环境 · 团队版起」. The deep-link case asserts the param is stripped and no `alertdialog` renders. Controls `setup_production` and `add_development` are unchanged and green.
- `EnvironmentListToolbar.deepLinkArming.test.tsx`: the two stand-in cases follow the renamed test id.
- `entitlements.test.ts` and `EnvironmentEntitlementDialog.test.tsx`: the `upgradeDialogSpec` cases are removed with the builder. The copy they shared with the reactive builder (capitalised "Your free plan", the translator, no URL means no CTA) is still pinned through `entitlementDialogFromError`.

Reverse check (round 1, at `bfb78e72`), from the committed state: `EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx` and `entitlements.ts` restored to the base `9646e2ed2`, the two toolbar test files run, then restored from `HEAD` (trap-guarded; restore proven by HEAD blob hashes and an empty `git diff HEAD`). Result on the old code: `Tests 7 failed | 17 passed (24)` — all seven new cases red, the deep-link one with `expected "vi.fn()" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times` and a `DEV_ENV_PLAN_LOCKED` spec; every control green. The deep-link red came from the round-1 `onUpgrade` spy, which round 2 removed with the prop.

## Local verification

Heavy runs through the shared verify lock.

**Round 2, at `e5c45317`** (after merging `origin/main` `6c437b07`): environment tests `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 65 passed (65)`; the 97-file consumer set, recomputed on this head, `Test Files 97 passed (97)`, `Tests 881 passed (881)`; `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check exit 0; app-shell lint 0 errors (3692 warnings; per touched file equal or lower); the light gates listed in the round-2 report all exit 0. No locale pack changed in round 2, so the i18n readings below stand.

**Round 1, at `bfb78e72`:**


- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/environment/`: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 65 passed (65)`.
- Narrowed `@object-ui/app-shell` consumer set, 97 files (every app-shell test naming `sys_environment`, `EnvironmentListToolbar`, `entitlements`, `EnvironmentEntitlementDialog`, `useNavRunAction` or `openEntitlementDialog`, every `useConsoleActionRuntime*` test, and every test importing `views/ObjectView`): `Test Files 97 passed (97)`, `Tests 881 passed (881)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFilesOnly` on the test config lists all six environment test files).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 83 passed (83)`, `Tests 1321 passed | 13 skipped (1334)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: 0 errors (3693 warnings, all pre-existing); per touched file, base vs head warning counts are equal or lower. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n lint`: 0 errors.
- Exit 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (`0 en value(s) changed (2 key(s) added, 1 removed`), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only; neither new key is a candidate), `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`), `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:self-import`.
- NOT MEASURED, declared: the full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite (1279 files); I stopped my own run after 22 minutes because two other agents were queued on the shared lock, so it has no reading. The narrowed set above replaces it locally; CI runs the full suite.
- NOT MEASURED, declared: `check:eager-locale-catalogues` needs a full console build (`apps/console/dist`). This diff adds and removes string values inside the packs and one relative import inside `src/environment/`; it moves no import edge into or out of a catalogue, which is what that gate weighs. CI's `performance-budget.yml` runs it on `packages/**`.
- Not browser-checked: no local control plane serves `/cloud/environment-entitlements`.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12190-env-list-locked-mark.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` minor. Removing `environment.addEnvironment` narrows a published surface of `@object-ui/i18n` (its packs and `TranslationKeys`), which is breaking for a consumer that reads the key. objectui scores a breaking change `minor` with the breaking note in the changeset prose, never `major` (`AGENTS.md` §9). The contract review `6122708969` (FAIL at `e5c4531`) asked for this; the round-1 `patch` choice is withdrawn.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured, not changed: the refusal dialog is still reachable from this page.** `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s api handler maps a coded 403 from any create POST to `entitlementDialogFromError` and opens the dialog, with an "Upgrade plan" CTA inside it. On this page that happens when a create the toolbar does render is refused, for example `add_development` from the row-derived fallback (`canCreateDevelopmentEnv` unknown) answered with `DEV_ENV_PLAN_LOCKED`. It opens after a server refusal, not from a primary paywall button.
- **The same branch serves an org at its development capacity.** `decideEnvironmentCta` returns `upgrade_for_development` whenever `development.canCreate` is `false`. Per the `DEV_ENV_LIMIT` copy, a paid org that has used its seat-scaled pool gets the same `false`. Before this PR it saw "Development environments are a paid feature"; now it sees "Team plan and up". This was not measured against the control plane (the cloud repository is not readable from this session). Telling the two apart needs `development.limit`, which `useEnvironmentEntitlements` does not map. That file was out of this card's surface.
- **Comments that described the retired proactive dialog** were rewritten in round 2 (`e5c45317`), with no behaviour change: the header of `EnvironmentEntitlementDialog.tsx`, the state comment above `entitlementDialog` in `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, the "or an upgrade prompt" comment above `environmentEntitlements` in `ObjectView.tsx`, and the `upgradeUrl` comment in `useEnvironmentEntitlements.ts`.
- **Left as is (carrier: none):** `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s returned `openEntitlementDialog` member is now read by nothing outside that hook; its reactive path calls the local callback. The runtime is not re-exported from the package entry. Retiring the member is a two-line edit in that file, which round 2 touched for comments only.
- The DOM test id rename (`environment-add-upgrade` → `environment-development-locked`) reaches any downstream end-to-end test that used it; none exists in this repository.
- Delivery (from the card): this reaches cloud only with cloud's v18 framework move. That is ordering, not a block.
